author: Mark332
quote:
This game is a complete woke slop. 

It has been gutted of some of the key features the GTA series is known for. Honestly one would think a company with such legacy would know better, but alas. Absolutely disgusting. Instead of humor and satire the series, you get a heavy load of wokeness shoved right down your throat, all while being infantilized by taking away freedoms to do whatever you want to, whoever you want within the game universe. Surely a bunch of wokies developing this game know better than you, the player, what's good and what's bad, and how you're not supposed to have fun in a video game. It's honestly surreal  to see this legendary series to die so anticlimactically right before our eyes. RIP GTA.
